title: El Paso Long Weekend
subtitle: MLK weekend · Jan 15–18, 2027. White Sands and Chamizal on Saturday, then Carlsbad Caverns and Guadalupe Mountains on the way back Sunday.

days.title: Fly to El Paso
days.html:
✈︎

OAK → PHX → ELP after work

Southwest WN 2941 departs Oakland 5:30 PM PT, connects in Phoenix (2.5-hr layover), and WN 4879 lands in El Paso at 12:05 AM MT. Conf. 2AVBGC. Basic fare: carry-on included, checked bags $45.

Pick up the round-trip rental at ELP (Costco Travel), then straight to bed at the Best Western Plus El Paso Airport Hotel.

Navigate to hotel ↗
Tonight: check the White Sands closures page. Missile tests can close the park and US-70 for up to three hours.
Time zone: Mountain time, 1 hr ahead of home. Every time in this book is local.

days.title: White Sands, Chamizal, then east
days.sub: El Paso → White Sands → Chamizal → Pine Springs → Carlsbad
days.cut: Chamizal is open Tue–Sat only, so today is its only chance. Pine Springs closes at 4:30; if you’re late, you’ll pass it again Sunday.

days.title: Caverns and mountains
days.sub: Carlsbad Caverns → Pine Springs → back to El Paso
days.cut: Pine Springs is closed Monday for MLK Day, so get Guadalupe today if you missed it Saturday. Pack snacks; the next real meal is El Paso.

stops.name: White Sands NP
stops.addr: White Sands National Park Visitor Center
stops.hrs: Open every day except Thanksgiving and Christmas. Winter hours vary; confirm the opening time in the NPS app.
stops.warn: Missile tests on the neighboring range can close the park and US-70 for up to three hours. Check the closures page before you go.
stops.ok: New park for the 64. Then Dunes Drive (~9:30): the pavement turns to packed sand, fine for a regular car. The Interdune Boardwalk is short and raised, with dune views from its end.
stops.about: The world’s largest gypsum dunefield, about 275 square miles of white sand in the Tularosa Basin.

stops.name: Chamizal NMem
stops.place: 800 S San Marcial St, El Paso
stops.addr: Chamizal National Memorial, 800 S San Marcial St, El Paso, TX 79905
stops.hrs: Tue–Sat 10:00–5:00. Today is the only day it’s open this weekend.
stops.ok: Quick lunch in El Paso after (~12:45), and fill the tank. There’s little along US-62/180 until Carlsbad.
stops.about: Marks the 1963 settlement of a century-long border dispute between the U.S. and Mexico over the shifting Rio Grande.

stops.optional: If time allows. Running late? Skip it; you’ll pass again Sunday morning.
stops.about: El Capitan’s cliff face stands right over the road. Guadalupe Peak behind it is the highest point in Texas, part of a fossil reef from an ancient sea.
stops.name: Guadalupe Mountains NP
stops.place: Pine Springs Visitor Center, Salt Flat, TX
stops.addr: Pine Springs Visitor Center, Guadalupe Mountains National Park

stops.name: Carlsbad, NM
stops.addr: Best Western Plus Executive Residency Carlsbad, 2601 Patrick St, Carlsbad, NM
stops.note: Best Western Plus Executive Residency Carlsbad, 2601 Patrick St. Early dinner and bed. Tomorrow starts at 7:30 AM after hotel breakfast.

stops.name: Carlsbad Caverns NP
stops.addr: Carlsbad Caverns National Park Visitor Center
stops.hrs: 8:00–5:00. No reservation needed for the visitor center; timed-entry tickets are only for going into the cave.
stops.ok: Stamp and a look at the exhibits, about 30 minutes. Optional: elevator into the Big Room (cavern entry 9:30–2:30, timed-entry ticket from recreation.gov). Skip it and you’re in El Paso by lunch.
stops.about: More than 100 caves lie under these hills. The Big Room is one of the largest cave chambers in North America.

stops.hrs: Open Sunday; closed Monday for MLK Day.
stops.ok: Still on Mountain time even if your phone flips to Central. Optional: Frijole Ranch, a short drive to an old ranch house in a shady spring oasis, steps from the parking lot.
stops.about: El Capitan’s cliff face stands right over the road. Guadalupe Peak behind it is the highest point in Texas, part of a fossil reef from an ancient sea.
stops.name: Guadalupe Mountains NP
stops.place: Pine Springs Visitor Center, Salt Flat, TX
stops.addr: Pine Springs Visitor Center, Guadalupe Mountains National Park

stops.name: El Paso
stops.addr: Best Western Plus El Paso Airport Hotel
stops.note: Lunch, then the Best Western Plus El Paso Airport Hotel. All four stamps done; the afternoon is yours.

stops.via: Sleep in, hotel breakfast, then return the rental at ELP around 11:30.
stops.title: El Paso → home
stops.note: Southwest WN 4815 to Austin, then WN 73 lands in Oakland at 6:25 PM PT (40-min connection). Conf. 2AVBGC.
